target: Caccetta–Häggkvist fixed n=18, r=6, no directed 2- or 3-cycles
statement: There is no loopless digraph on 18 vertices with minimum outdegree >=6 and directed girth >=4.
requirement: A satisfying assignment must be independently decoded and checked; an UNSAT solver verdict alone is not a proof and requires an externally checked proof trace.
